Name: Transmutation Recipes (Iridium and Radioactive)
Author: bansaighdear
Description:
Allows you to transmute
- iridium bars from gold bars. Recipe is received when reaching Mining Level 9.
- radioactive bars from iridium bars. Recipe is received when reaching Mining Level 10.

Downloads.Description: First release with manifest updated to fix SMAPI giving an error. :)
